about:
I'm a **Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** with professional experience in developing, enhancing, and maintaining enterprise web applications. My primary specialization is **.NET Backend and Full-Stack Development**, with experience in **C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET 8, ASP.NET MVC, React.js, and RESTful APIs**.

I have hands-on experience in **backend development, API integrations, authentication mechanisms, database operations, and application logging**. I've worked with relational databases such as **Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL**, along with enterprise application development and maintenance workflows.

Beyond application development, I'm interested in **Cloud Computing, DevOps, and modern software engineering practices**. I hold the **Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)** certification and continue to explore cloud technologies and infrastructure concepts.

I'm also passionate about **Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI**, particularly **Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-assisted software development**. I've earned the **Claude Certified Associate - Foundations** certification and actively explore AI-powered development tools such as **GitHub Copilot and Claude** to improve development productivity and problem-solving.

In my day-to-day professional environment, I work with tools such as **Jira, Confluence, Git, GitHub, and NLog**, and participate in collaborative development workflows following **Agile and Scrum practices**.

I also enjoy building personal projects, exploring emerging technologies, and continuously improving my understanding of **software architecture, clean code, and scalable application development**.

My goal is to build **reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions** while continuously growing as a well-rounded software engineer.
